Discover upscale waterfront living at Regency Luxury Suites Marina, offering fully furnished 1 Bedroom and 2 Bedroom apartments in the heart of Dubai Marina. Perfect for business travelers, families, and long-term residents, these spacious apartments combine comfort, convenience, and premium amenities. 

Each apartment is fully equipped with modern essentials, including a refrigerator, microwave, washer-dryer machine, complimentary Wi-Fi, and multi-channel satellite TV. With all utility bills included, residents can enjoy a seamless and worry-free stay. 

The property features a range of lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, covered parking, and 24-hour concierge and security services. Housekeeping is provided twice weekly, while periodic and on-demand maintenance services ensure a comfortable living experience throughout your stay. 

Property Features & Amenities:
• Fully furnished apartments 
• 1 Bedroom and 2 Bedroom options available 
• Utility bills included 
• Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi 
• Housekeeping services twice a week 
• Refrigerator and microwave 
• Washer and dryer machine 
• Multi-channel satellite TV 
• Swimming pool access 
• Fully equipped gym 
• Covered parking space 
• Periodic and on-demand maintenance services 
• 24-hour concierge and security 

Available Apartment Types:
• 1 Bedroom Apartments 
• 2 Bedroom Apartments 

Pricing:
Rental rates vary depending on the apartment size, layout, and availability. Contact us for the latest rates and available units.
